notes.title: Armed Animals RPG - RELEASE!
notes.notes: [p]Hey, [/p][p]so I´ve finally released my game, a project I have spent the majority of my free time for the last two years. As much as this is an even to me, this does not mean I will stop working on the game, far from it, I´m going to polish cosmetic stuff, fix bugs, and add new features and content. [/p][p][/p][p]So... What can you expect from the game as is right now? [/p][p]Well, there´s a lot. [/p][p]•The game has a main quest with five completely different achievable endings, and a few more secret endings are yet to come. [/p][p]•The game boasts a full arsenal of weapons, from dimpy antique revolvers, through heavy aircraft machineguns to weird sci-fi inventions of the animal civilisation. [/p][p]•The game is fully voice acted, you can talk to civillians and unique NPCs alike (and sometimes to enemies too!)[/p][p]•Lots of side-quests and side activities, you can work out in the famous Ostružina´s gym, play videogames in the librar- ehm I mean arcades (some of which are to come), and just go explore and find friends or enemies. [/p][p]•A very in-depth health system relying on YOU to diagnose and find the cure. No "you have low blood iron" signs or meter flickers or beeps here - you need to watch out for your character yourself, and watch him closely.[/p][p]•A gradually more and more populated bunker, as you free prisoners or make other rebellious animals join you.[/p][p][/p][p]So go out there, and avenge general Nejedlý[b]’[/b]s death! Flosscat needs to pay![/p][p]Your [/p][p]Strejda Jenda Productions[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597913/901f12ea62f8913b4978f95be8e498de3d13ab4c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch + ponder point update
notes.notes: [p]Patched the bug that made the wrong NPC talk upon talking to an NPC. This would also cause multiple NPCs to talk over each other, because I´m an idiot and I did not understando how the code o my own game works, which I have learned since.[/p][p]Also added a cutscene of general Nejedlý in the "Ponder" menu. It´s still WIP, especially regarding captain Flosscat´s voice acting and audio balancing. Watching it will allow for stuff in future updates that´s not there yet.[/p]
